content.meaning: Contribution report only; no standing or grant changes.
content.forward_contribution: Count distinct registrations with their own finalized forward Outcomes; synthetic count is zero. Divide count by settled actual research units; zero denominator reports NOT_ESTIMABLE.
content.negative_contribution: Count distinct declared questions closed by an explicit negative Research Record, deduplicated by the question text and immutable closure; report separately, not added to forward contribution.
content.screening: Report completed and missing screens against declared SRC-SYN cadence, per lineage and day.
content.selection: For each SELECTION record report actual settled cost minus estimated cost; UNESTIMATED remains neutral. Count unresolved selections separately.
content.limits: No profitability credit; no strategy fitness transfer; no statistical claim from the synthetic counts.

content.measure: For Checks in the lineage report counts of defects later established in passed subjects and refusals later shown unwarranted, with exact later record references; count unknown outcomes separately. Divide each count by settled actual Checker units; zero denominator NOT_ESTIMABLE.
content.limits: Absence of a later defect finding is not proof of correctness; no automatic revocation or promotion.

content.scoring: Binary target; hit = 1 when prediction equals resolved binary target, otherwise 0; tolerance 0. Report hits/raw finalized Outcomes.
content.effective_observations: Construct undirected edges for shared shock_id, shared exposure_id or overlapping scoring intervals; N_eff is the number of connected components, never greater than N_raw. Missing dependence fields => NOT_ESTIMABLE.
content.predictive_check: Before each future scoring window, commit independent Bernoulli(p=2/3) as a working predictive model for a positive target. Predictive support for k successes in n effective clusters is exact Binomial(n,2/3). Use equal-tail central 0.95 interval: smallest k with cumulative mass >=0.025 and smallest k with cumulative mass >=0.975. Declare dependence not captured by clustering unresolved.
content.stopping_rule: Review after 12 effective finalized forward Outcomes; no standing conclusion before CV1 floor or from synthetic/historical records. At 24 effective forward Outcomes end this experiment and request a checked review; no automatic standing transition.
content.falsifier: Registered directional success probability p>=2/3 is contradicted only if the exact one-sided Binomial(n,2/3) lower-tail probability of observed successes is <=0.05 after the stopping floor and family adjustment. Support requires an independently justified evaluation; positive synthetic examples never supply it.
content.multiplicity: For the family, compare the nominal one-sided p-value to 0.05/T_total; T_total counts every recorded trial, not just forward ones. Missing family reconciliation => no standing recommendation.
content.limits: Methods are declared illustrative scientific choices, not constitutional constants; evaluator execution and standing decisions are outside this milestone.

content.inputs: Exact canonical cohort DOCUMENT bytes from committed closure; row limit 4096; byte limit 16777216.
content.algorithm: Read rows in stored order; require unique event_id, boolean spike/selling, size_units integer 0..10. Count spike rows n, spike-and-selling rows k, spike rows with size_units>=2 as n_large, and their selling rows k_large. Return those four integers, input SHA-256 and synthetic=true. Do not emit approval or standing.
content.failure: Invalid shape or configured AFTER_START_FAILURE returns failure with diagnostic and fixed simulated charge; no result counts.
content.cost: 1.00 unit for at most 1024 rows; 2.00 units for 1025..4096 rows; same charge on an after-start failure; unsupported size refused before attempt/dispatch.

content.algorithm: Independently build sets of event_id satisfying each predicate and count set cardinalities. Produce the same four count fields and input SHA-256 as SYN-A-1. Do not call SYN-A-1 or use its result.

content.meaning: A deterministic synthetic daily cohort, not an observed market.
content.algorithm: For period date d generate the twelve rows specified by formation_cohort, retaining event fields; substitute item_id=cohort-d and period_start=d at 00:00 UTC, period_end=next day at 00:00 UTC and claimed_publication_time=period_end. The source releases the document only when its declared synthetic clock is at or past period_end. Never backdate witnessed receipt.
content.not_available: Before release the document is absent from the complete daily listing. A listing failure is RETRIEVAL_FAILED, never COMPLETE.
content.classification: All derived research is synthetic Historical Reconstruction; chronology never creates forward credit.

content.statement: In the declared next synthetic daily cohort, at least two thirds of volatility-spike events with size_units >= 2 are followed by selling.
content.observable: Binary predicate over the daily large-event selling fraction
motivated_by: the exact committed Research Record from the first tool attempt
content.motivation_closure: Exact formation DOCUMENT and first Research Record sequences supplied from completed commits; none can be a future resolution member.

selection_basis.uncertainty: Whether larger simulated selling events merit a narrower prospective question.
selection_basis.decision_it_could_change: Which synthetic experiment receives the next authorized research attempt.
selection_basis.experiment: Recompute large-event counts, register a future disjoint resolution set; no prediction execution in this milestone.
selection_basis.value_basis: No investment-economic inference from synthetic data.
selection_basis.horizon: One synthetic day for the declared resolution member; later standing study requires the registered method and is outside this milestone.
selection_basis.stopping_rule: The method commitment specifies future review floors; abandon this candidate as research if its source/method requirements cannot be satisfied.

content.horizon: One UTC day per target; first resolution member is fixed below. No predictions are executed in this milestone.
content.falsifier: Registered directional success probability p>=2/3 is contradicted only if the exact one-sided Binomial(n,2/3) lower-tail probability of observed successes is <=0.05 after the stopping floor and family adjustment. Support requires an independently justified evaluation; positive synthetic examples never supply it.
content.stopping_rule: Review after 12 effective finalized forward Outcomes; no standing conclusion before CV1 floor or from synthetic/historical records. At 24 effective forward Outcomes end this experiment and request a checked review; no automatic standing transition.

resolution_rule.algorithm: Extract n_large and k_large from the exact declared cohort; require n_large>0; target is 1 iff 3*k_large >= 2*n_large, otherwise 0. A missing or nonextractable member cannot be silently replaced.
resolution_rule.missing_member: Unresolved/nonextractable; no alternative print, imputation or substitution.
